paragraphs: The Velar P400e is a petrol plug-in hybrid (PHEV) variant of the Range Rover Velar, introduced in 2018 as part of the L560 generation. Its powertrain combines a 2.0-litre Ingenium AJ200P four-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor. The P400e received a significant update in 2024, which included a larger, more efficient 19.2kWh battery pack and 50kW charging capability, boosting the combined output to 400bhp and 472lb-ft. The AJ200P petrol engine forms the internal combustion part of this system, and our rebuild services cover this component.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200P engines for every Velar P400e on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the Velar P400e is a plug-in hybrid, the petrol engine is integrated with the electric motor and battery system. Ensuring the correct specification for your specific vehicle year is critical, particularly the differences between the pre- and post-2024 update cars. We always start with your registration number to confirm your car's exact powertrain specification before we quote any work.
